message.content: According to the discussions, Evangeline expresses enthusiasm for Real Madrid's history in the Champions League, particularly noting their ability to come back from difficult situations. She highlights a notable comeback victory against Manchester City in the 2022 Champions League, mentioning the stoppage-time goal scored by Rodrygo that turned the match around. Evangeline emphasizes the "never-say-die attitude" of Real Madrid and the importance of their fans' support during those nail-biting moments. She also points out the club's legendary history in the competition, indicating that their winning culture is deeply ingrained in the team's ethos. Evangeline seems to appreciate how the team rises to the occasion, especially when the odds seem to be against them, which she views as a testament to their resilience and determination.
